description: This PHP script handles network diagnostic tools such as ping and traceroute, processing AJAX POST requests to perform connectivity tests for IPv4, IPv6, and trace routes, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: test_connectivity
methods.description: Performs ping tests to IPv4, IPv6 addresses and checks connectivity status, returning JSON results.

methods.name: destination_ipv4
methods.description: Performs ping test to an IPv4 address and returns connectivity status.

methods.name: destination_ipv6
methods.description: Performs ping test to an IPv6 address and returns connectivity status.

methods.name: trace_ipv4_dst
methods.description: Performs traceroute to an IPv4 address and returns hop details.

methods.name: trace_ipv6_dst
methods.description: Performs traceroute to an IPv6 address and returns hop details.
